policies.title: Reform welfare, cut spending
policies.statement: Find £47 billion in savings by reforming welfare and getting people back into work, with half of all savings used to reduce the deficit.

policies.title: Scrap the 2050 Net Zero target
policies.statement: Abandon the legally binding 2050 Net Zero target, expand North Sea oil and gas licensing, and cut household electricity costs.

policies.title: Leave the ECHR to control borders
policies.statement: Leave the European Convention on Human Rights and launch a BORDERS plan targeting 150,000 removals a year of people with no right to be in the UK.

policies.title: Cut property and business taxes
policies.statement: Abolish stamp duty on primary residences and scrap business rates to boost home ownership and high street investment.

policies.title: Tougher policing and sentencing
policies.statement: Put 10,000 more police officers into high-crime hotspots, roll out live facial recognition, and introduce 'Immediate Justice' community sentences.

policies.title: Protect core public services
policies.statement: Ban smartphones in schools, legislate minimum NHS service levels, and prohibit strikes by doctors that put patients at risk.
